# stalwart_memory_lookup_key (Resource)

Defines an in-memory lookup key for fast data access.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key name
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the key

### Optional

- `is_glob_pattern` (Boolean) Whether the key is a glob pattern

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
